name: North Macedonia (Vergina Sun, 1992–1995)
description: A red field with a yellow sixteen-rayed Vergina Sun in the centre.
history: The first flag of the independent Republic of Macedonia, adopted on 11 August 1992 with the Vergina Sun found at the burial ground of the ancient Macedonian kings at Aegae. Greece regarded the symbol as its own and imposed a trade blockade; under the interim accord of 1995 the flag was replaced on 5 October 1995 by Miroslav Grčev's eight-rayed sun.
